summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for the 2026/27 season with just one week to go, having welcomed some exciting new signings and one returning player to strengthen their squad. The Ramblers recently faced St Helens in a competitive friendly, with their opponents capitalizing on their chances to edge the tight contest. With three brand new kits and fresh additions to the team, the club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities as they prepare to push for promotion.
